specs.title: Dispatch Map Component

drifted.spec_text: System MUST use the ILogger receptacle for info, debug, and error logging throughout the component.
drifted.actual: Only logger.info and logger.debug are called; logger.error is never invoked on any fallible/error-return path.

drifted.spec_text: On initialization, the IEvictionPolicy receptacle MUST be connected (returns an error if unbound).
drifted.actual: initialize() calls get_pool_id() which does eviction_policy.get().unwrap(), panicking on an unbound receptacle instead of returning DispatchMapError::NotInitialized; the map_err guard is unreachable in that case.

drifted.spec_text: The DispatchEntry struct size varies by Location variant.
drifted.actual: Location is a Rust enum sized to its largest variant at compile time; size_of::<DispatchEntry>() is a fixed constant, not per-instance variable.

not_implemented: US2-AS4 (lookup size-mismatch -> MismatchSize; lookup takes no expected-size parameter)

unspecced.feature: integrity-check feature: checksum field + set_checksum/get_checksum methods (CRC-32)
